text_block_list.text:
One day, Дайва Скарлет goes on a picnic
with her
classmates.

No waaaaay! A suspension bridge?! How
are we
supposed to cross this?!
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text:
(Huh?! This has to be some kind of joke!
Those
little planks are spaced way too
far apart!)
text_block_list.name: Дайва Скарлет

text_block_list.text:
(This is scary. But if I bow out now,
there'll be no
one to help the others!
...All right!)
text_block_list.name: Дайва Скарлет

text_block_list.text:
We won't get anywhere at this rate!
Everyone,
hold onto my hand!
text_block_list.name: Дайва Скарлет

text_block_list.text: Phew... We all made it.
text_block_list.name: Дайва Скарлет

text_block_list.text: Geez, that was terrifying!
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text:
Right? I thought we were goners, to be
honest.
text_block_list.name: Дайва Скарлет

text_block_list.text:
Come on, Scarlet. You had a blank look
on your
face that whole time.
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ Б

text_block_list.text:
Just like a model student to keep her
cool. I feel
like we can't even compete.
text_block_list.name: Umamusume C

text_block_list.text:
Okay, onto our next spot. Can't wait to
see what
challenges we're gonna have to
deal with next! ♪
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ Б

text_block_list.text:
Uh, wait, hold on. Honestly, I was
pretty—hey!
Wait up!
text_block_list.name: Дайва Скарлет

text_block_list.text: Woosh!

What the heck? That makes it sound
like...
text_block_list.name: Дайва Скарлет

text_block_list.text: Like I'm some boring stick-in-the-mud!
text_block_list.name: Дайва Скарлет

text_block_list.text:
In the yard behind Академия Тайсен, the
place
where everyone vents in secret,
Дайва Скарлет
cries out.

I was super scared too, you know! I just
wanted to
be the most reliable—the
most dependable!
text_block_list.name: Дайва Скарлет

text_block_list.text:
It's not like I wanted to ruin their fun at
the picnic!
This is all so stupid! Stupid!
STUPID!
text_block_list.name: Дайва Скарлет

text_block_list.text:
I figure out the gist of what happened
from her
yelling.
Grr! Fine. The next time something crazy happens, I'll make sure I have the most frightened reaction out of everyone!
text_block_list.name: Дайва Скарлет

text_block_list.text:
Wait, would that be too much? I'd feel
pretty
fake doing that... Ugh, this is so
confusing...
text_block_list.name: Дайва Скарлет
choice_data_list: Um, do you mind if I say something?

text_block_list.text:
EEEEK! Where'd you come from?! Tch!
Did you
hear all of that?!
text_block_list.name: Дайва Скарлет

text_block_list.text:
After all my eavesdropping, I decide to
offer her
some words of advice.
choice_data_list: I think practicing your reactions is a great idea.
Just stick with what feels natural to you.

text_block_list.text:
Practice my reactions?! Ugh. So you
really heard
everything...
text_block_list.name: Дайва Скарлет

text_block_list.text:
But you're right. Thank you. I'll go watch

UmaTube for some pointers...
text_block_list.name: Дайва Скарлет

text_block_list.text: Get a load of this. You wouldn't believe what happened to me в тренировке.
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ Б

text_block_list.text: Wowww, that's so wild.
text_block_list.name: Umamusume C

text_block_list.text:
(Ooh! This is my chance! Time to put my
reaction
training to use!)
text_block_list.name: Дайва Скарлет

text_block_list.text:
OH. EM. GEE! That is, like, soooo crazy!
Like, get
out! I'm on the edge of my seat
here!
text_block_list.name: Дайва Скарлет

text_block_list.text: Uh, are you okay, Scarlet?
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ Б

text_block_list.text:
Whaddya think? I sound super engaged,
right?
text_block_list.name: Дайва Скарлет

text_block_list.text: Hmm, I'm not sure that's how I'd put it.
text_block_list.name: Umamusume C

text_block_list.text:
...You really went all-in on the act,
though. That
was such a good UmaTuber
impression, it caught
me off guard.
text_block_list.name: Umamusume C

text_block_list.text: A-a good what?!
text_block_list.name: Дайва Скарлет

text_block_list.text:
(Ugh. I guess those UmaTuber reaction
videos
aren't the best reference after all.
But still...)
text_block_list.name: Дайва Скарлет

text_block_list.text: I won't give up! Just you wait, I'm going to be the most fun person around! With the best reactions ever!
text_block_list.name: Дайва Скарлет

text_block_list.text:
Whatever feels natural... Yeah, I guess
you're
right. I should just be myself.
text_block_list.name: Дайва Скарлет

text_block_list.text: Thanks very much! I get it now!
text_block_list.name: Дайва Скарлет

text_block_list.text:
Дайва Скарлет speeds off. Then, a few
days later...

Hey, Scarlet! Did you hear? We're gonna
have a
surprise pop quiz next class!
text_block_list.name: Umamusume C

text_block_list.text: A quiz? Really?
text_block_list.name: Дайва Скарлет

text_block_list.text:
Well, no use panicking. I'll just take it in
stride
and think of it as a chance to show
what I can do.
text_block_list.name: Дайва Скарлет

text_block_list.text:
Whoa. Your composure never ceases to
impress...
text_block_list.name: Umamusume C

text_block_list.text:
Hey Scarlet, perfect timing. Just wanted
to let
you know...
text_block_list.name: Водка

text_block_list.text:
I borrowed one of your scarves to polish
my
leather jacket. 'Kay, thanks, seeya.
text_block_list.name: Водка

text_block_list.text: Excuse me?! What the heck were you thinking?!
text_block_list.name: Дайва Скарлет

text_block_list.text:
Who gave you permission to use my
scarf?! I'm
gonna use your jacket to
polish my scarf!
text_block_list.name: Дайва Скарлет

text_block_list.text:
Whoa, Scarlet always seemed so
laid-back
around us...
text_block_list.name: Umamusume C

text_block_list.text:
Yeah but it looks like she's got a quick
temper
with her friends. She's funny.
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ Б

text_block_list.text:
Дайва Скарлет, the normally unfazed
model
student, mercilessly lays into one
of her closest
friends.

Дайва Скарлет's sheer passion burns as
she vows to
start having a total blast
whenever possible.
